item.title: Unkernel: Real Linux kernel, compiled to WebAssembly
Knuth: Moratorium on Error Reports
item.description:
📝 For more than fifty years I've been welcoming reports from readers of errors in my books, so that I can correct them before new copies are printed. Alas, the rise of LLMs has increased the productivity of my readers so greatly that error reports are now being submitted much faster than I can read them. Random sampling indicates that the vast majority of errors that have been reported in recent weeks are repeats of issues already submitted by others.
🔗 Read more: https://www-cs-faculty.stanford.edu/~knuth/moratorium.html

item.title: Paolo Soleri built a utopian eco-city in the Arizona desert
item.description:
📝 Save StorySave this storySave StorySave this storyFrom the tops of cypress trees, an assemblage of Brutalist buildings rises amid the high Sonoran Desert in Arizona – Arcosanti, Paolo Soleri’s unfinished, 860-acre prototype city, which began construction in 1970 and is more relevant today than ever. In reality, numbers have never reached more than 150 and, today, just two dozen people carry on Soleri’s work. ‘I feel like this is the future,’ he says.
🔗 Read more: https://www.worldofinteriors.com/story/paolo-soleri-arconsati-arizona
